_documentation.purpose: Editions of the NetSec Training School (the COST Training School deliverable, run as the Early-Career Scholars Summer School / ECS³). Drives two modules on summer-school.html (+ FR + DE) via assets/js/training-school.js, renderer-light: the forward-looking 'Next call' module and the 'Editions' archive. The rich prose sections (About, Taking part, heritage) stay hand-authored in the page.

schema.status: 'past' | 'announced' | 'call-open'. 'past' renders in the archive with no calendar. 'announced'/'call-open' render the Next-call module; the Add-to-calendar affordance shows only when a real start date is present (an announced-but-undated edition shows 'To be announced' and no calendar).
schema.host: string host institution, or 'To be announced'.
schema.dates: human dates string, or 'To be announced'.
schema.start: optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Presence gates the calendar affordance + links the events.json .ics.
schema.ics: optional calendar slug under /calendar/<slug>.ics (only meaningful with a start date).
schema.coordinators: optional array of { name, affiliation, member_id? } — member_id deep-links to the directory.
schema.photos: optional array of { src, alt } for the edition gallery; the renderer omits any src that 404s.
schema.summary: optional one-paragraph blurb for the edition card.

_documentation.note: Photos for 2026 live under assets/images/summer-school/2026/. Add new editions by appending a record; flip an upcoming edition's status + fill start/ics when it is announced.
